answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust from verified seeds with a walk capped at \(t\) steps; each transition crosses one edge, bounding reach and voting influence. A quill-signed sybil vertex cluster joined to honest vertices by a sparse cut has low conductance, so little walk probability enters from the seed region. With bounded edge weights, min-cut and transitivity bounds cap its aggregate vote by incoming cut flow, not its karst-like interior’s size.
